class.name: Mage
class.text: A mage does damage with a cast bar and a mana bar, and the craft is in what to cast and when to stand still. Frost slows and freezes, Fire hits hardest, Arcane saves mana. Every line below presses a button.

card.caresAbout: mana left, the cast bar, distance, and what is slowed or frozen
card.vocabulary: cast, bolt, mana, range, slow, freeze, sheep, cooldown
card.soundsLike: dry and numerate, quick to give a count (30 yards, 8 seconds) and short on adjectives. A mage line says when to stand still and when to move
card.neverSays: rage, swing as the main action, anything mystical ("the weave", "arcane secrets", "power of")
card.test: could it be read between two casts?

advice.say: Frost. The safest way to level alone. A frozen or slowed monster hits you less. The price: Frost hits a little softer than Fire. Fire. The hardest hit. Fire has no slow, so Frostbolt and Frost Nova stay on the bar. The price: a monster that reaches you stays on you. Arcane. Mana and free spells. The price: most of the tree's damage arrives with Arcane Power at 40, so before then you level slower than the other two.

builds.name: Frost
builds.intro: Frost keeps the monster slow or frozen so it hits you less, and kills with Frostbolt. It is the mage that survives being alone.
builds.pathNote: (31 points in Frost for Ice Barrier, then 20 in Arcane).
builds.split: the last 20 points. A second road puts them in Fire (Improved Fireball, Impact, Ignite) for a mage who wants a harder hit. It gives you a bigger opening and gives up the free spells and the spell resistance. This page takes Arcane for the mana.

path.why: Frostbolt casts 0.5 seconds faster, and it is your main button.
A Frost or Fire spell is 6% less likely to be resisted.
A chilled monster has a 15% chance to freeze for 5 seconds at 3/3.
6% more Frost damage.
Frost Nova comes back 4 seconds sooner, and it opens Shatter.
Spells are 50% more likely to be critical against a frozen monster.
You are safe from everything for 10 seconds, but cannot do anything, and it takes 5 minutes to come back. It opens Ice Barrier.
Cone of Cold hits 35% harder.
Each Frost hit raises the chance of a Frost critical on that target by 2%, up to 5 times.
A shield on you that absorbs damage for a minute, and spells are not interrupted while it holds.
Arcane spells are resisted 10% less. Mostly the way to the next row.
The target resists your spells less, and Arcane spells draw 40% less threat.
Any damage spell has a 10% chance to make the next one cost nothing.
25% more damage with a wand, and a wand costs no mana.
All resistances up 10, and a fully resisted spell gives back 5% of your mana.
Armour equal to half your Intellect. The last point. Any talent you can reach would do as well.

stages.opening: Frost Armor on, Arcane Intellect, Frostbolt from range, step back as it slows, Fire Blast to finish. Wand when mana runs low.

rows.say: Put it on yourself. It adds armour for 30 minutes, so renew it between fights and not in them.
rows.name: Frost Armor

rows.say: Cast it on yourself. 30 minutes of extra Intellect means more mana to spend.
rows.name: Arcane Intellect

rows.say: Your opener at 35 yards. The cast takes longer with each rank, so you want the monster far away when it starts.
rows.name: Fireball

rows.say: Opens at 30 yards and slows the monster by 40% for 5 seconds. It arrives later and you cast again before it does.
rows.name: Frostbolt

rows.say: Press it as the monster arrives or runs. It has no cast bar, so it fills the gap between casts.
rows.name: Fire Blast

rows.say: Hits once a second for 3 seconds, and you cannot move for any of it. Use it only when nothing will reach you while it lasts.
rows.name: Arcane Missiles

rows.say: A sheep for up to 20 seconds. It works on Beasts, Humanoids and Critters, and any damage wakes it, so leave it alone.
rows.name: Polymorph

rows.say: Make drinks before you need them. Sitting with one brings mana back and saves a vendor trip.
rows.name: Conjure Water

rows.say: Makes food. Eat between fights to get health back without spending any mana.
rows.name: Conjure Food

stages.opening: Frost Armor on, Frostbolt from 30 yards, Frostbolt again, Frost Nova when it arrives, walk back and cast, Fire Blast or wand to finish.

rows.say: Your main button, and it slows the monster by 40%. Cast it from as far as 30 yards.
rows.name: Frostbolt

rows.say: Freezes everything near you for up to 8 seconds. Walk back, because damage breaks the freeze and the point is distance.
rows.name: Frost Nova

rows.say: No cast bar, ready every 8 seconds. It finishes a fight a Frostbolt would not.
rows.name: Fire Blast

rows.say: Hits everything around you at once. It is your answer when a second monster joins.
rows.name: Arcane Explosion

rows.say: Turn one into a sheep for up to 20 seconds and deal with the other first.
rows.name: Polymorph

rows.say: Renew it when it ends.
rows.name: Frost Armor

stages.about: One monster, or two, and the first dungeons.
stages.opening: Frostbolt, Frostbolt, Frost Nova if it reaches you, Fire Blast. Ice Armor from 30.

rows.say: Still your main button. Its cast reaches 3 seconds at rank 5, so start it while the monster is far.
rows.name: Frostbolt

rows.say: Freeze, step back, cast. It comes back in 25 seconds, or 21 with Improved Frost Nova.
rows.name: Frost Nova

rows.say: Hits everything in front of you and slows it 50% for 8 seconds, ready every 10.
rows.name: Cone of Cold

rows.say: Stand still and it rains ice for 8 seconds on the ground you chose. Pull a pack into it.
rows.name: Blizzard

rows.say: Stops a spell and its whole school for 10 seconds. It takes 30 seconds to come back.
rows.name: Counterspell

rows.say: Moves you 20 yards and frees you from stuns and roots. It takes 15 seconds to come back.
rows.name: Blink

rows.say: 8 seconds of standing still that brings back mana much faster. It takes 8 minutes to come back, so use it once per long outing.
rows.name: Evocation

rows.say: Replaces Frost Armor, with more armour and a slow on melee attackers.
rows.name: Ice Armor

rows.say: Absorbs damage by draining mana instead. Press it when you would die before you ran dry.
rows.name: Mana Shield

rows.say: Safe from everything for 10 seconds, but you cannot act, and it takes 5 minutes to come back.
rows.name: Ice Block

stages.about: Dungeons, hard monsters and the first raid.
stages.opening: Ice Barrier, Frostbolt from 30 yards, Frost Nova, Cone of Cold.

rows.say: A shield on you that absorbs damage, and spells are not interrupted while it holds. It takes 30 seconds to come back.
rows.name: Ice Barrier

rows.say: Your main button. Each hit adds a Winter's Chill stack, up to 5, and each stack raises your Frost critical chance on that monster by 2%.
rows.name: Frostbolt

rows.say: Freeze, step back, cast. Shatter raises your critical chance against a frozen monster by 50%.
rows.name: Frost Nova

rows.say: Hits harder with Improved Cone of Cold and slows 50% for 8 seconds.
rows.name: Cone of Cold

rows.say: 8 seconds of ice on the ground. Use it with a Frost Nova between you and them.
rows.name: Blizzard

rows.say: Stops the school for 10 seconds, ready every 30.
rows.name: Counterspell

rows.say: Keeps 30% of mana regeneration going while you cast. Use it when mana, not health, runs out first.
rows.name: Mage Armor

rows.say: Safe for 10 seconds, but you cannot act, and it takes 5 minutes to come back.
rows.name: Ice Block

rows.say: 8 seconds of standing still for a lot of mana back. 8 minutes to come back.
rows.name: Evocation

builds.name: Fire
builds.intro: Fire hits hardest and sets the monster burning. It has no slow of its own, so the page gives you Frostbolt and Frost Nova for distance.
builds.pathNote: (31 points in Fire for Combustion, then 20 in Frost).
builds.split: the last 20 points. A second road puts them in Arcane (Arcane Focus, Arcane Concentration, Arcane Subtlety) for a mage who wants free spells and a bigger mana bar. It gives up the slow and the freeze, which are what keeps a Fire mage alive when the monster arrives. This page takes Frost for that reason.
builds.dry: Combustion held back is a lot of critical hits not dealt.

path.why: Fireball casts 0.5 seconds faster, and it is your main button.
A critical Fire hit sets the target burning for another 40% of the damage over 4 seconds.
A big hit with a 6 second cast, and a burn after it. Open with it from 35 yards.
Fire spells reach 6 yards further, so you open from further away.
Fire Blast and Scorch are 4% more likely to be critical.
A critical Fire or Frost spell gives back 30% of its mana.
A Scorch makes the target take 3% more Fire damage, stacking to 5 times.
6% more critical chance on Fire spells.
Damages and dazes all enemies near you, every 45 seconds.
10% more Fire damage.
Each Fire hit raises your critical chance by 10% until you have had 3 criticals. Every 3 minutes.
A Fire or Frost spell is 6% less likely to be resisted.
Frostbolt casts 0.5 seconds faster, so the slow you rely on comes sooner.
A chilled monster has a 15% chance to freeze for 5 seconds.
Frost Nova comes back 4 seconds sooner.
A chill lasts 3 seconds longer and slows 10% more.
Finishes the cooldown on all your Frost spells. Every 10 minutes.
Frost spells cost 15% less mana and draw 30% less threat.

rows.say: When you need it slowed. It costs less than Fireball at the same rank, so it is also the cheaper hit.

stages.opening: Pyroblast from 35 yards, Fireball, Frost Nova if it reaches you, Fire Blast.

rows.say: A 6 second cast and a burn after it. Open with it from 35 yards, because it lands before the monster can reach you.
rows.name: Pyroblast

rows.say: The main button. Its cast time grows with rank, so open with your highest rank and finish with lower ones.
rows.name: Fireball

rows.say: A 1.5 second cast that costs far less than a Fireball of the same level. Use it to finish a monster when mana is short.
rows.name: Scorch

rows.say: Instant. Press it when it reaches you or runs.
rows.name: Fire Blast

rows.say: Freezes it for up to 8 seconds. Step back and keep casting, because it cannot hit you.

rows.say: Damages and dazes all near you, every 45 seconds. Use it when a pack arrives.

rows.say: Absorbs Fire damage for 30 seconds. Only press it for a monster that casts fire.

builds.name: Arcane
builds.intro: Arcane runs on mana and on spells that cost nothing. It is slow before 40 and good after, for a mage who would rather cast than flee.
builds.pathNote: (31 points in Arcane for Arcane Power, then 20 in Fire).
builds.split: the last 20 points. A second road puts them in Frost (Improved Frostbolt, Frostbite, Permafrost) for a mage who needs the slow. This page takes Fire for the harder hit, and the price is the slow that keeps you alive.

path.why: Arcane spells are resisted 10% less.
Any damage spell has a 10% chance to make the next one cost nothing.
Arcane Missiles is not broken when you are hit.
15% of your mana regeneration continues while you cast.
Armour equal to half your Intellect. It opens Arcane Mind.
Counterspell silences the target for 4 seconds, every time.
Your next spell with a cast under 10 seconds becomes instant. Every 3 minutes.
10% more mana.

Spells deal 30% more damage and cost 30% more mana for 15 seconds. Every 3 minutes.
Fireball casts 0.5 seconds faster.
Fire spells have a 10% chance to stun for 2 seconds.
A critical Fire hit sets the target burning for 40% more.
Fire spells reach 6 yards further.
Fire Blast comes back 1.5 seconds sooner.
